# bananana

> A one-page website where every click or tap makes it rain banana emoji across the screen. Purely for fun, no signup, no backend.

## Pages

- [bananana](https://bananana.example.com/): The whole site. Click or tap anywhere and banana emoji fall from the top of the screen, spinning and drifting down, for a few seconds before disappearing.

## Notes

- Single static HTML page, no login, no data collection.
- Interaction: any click or tap triggers a burst of animated banana emoji.
